page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core, meaning hyperthreading is not active. The instance is provisioned with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

A defining characteristic of this server is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. The network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. No graphics processing units (GPUs) are included in this configuration, and there are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is its reliance on HDD storage rather than solid-state drives (SSDs). While this provides exceptionally high storage density and capacity at a lower qualitative cost per gigabyte, it limits random input and output operations per second (IOPS) compared to SSD-backed instances. Consequently, this server is suited for workloads requiring massive sequential storage capacity, such as large-scale data warehousing, log processing, cold data archiving, and distributed file systems like HDFS, rather than high-IOPS transactional databases.
